decisions.decision: Use separate hwm-context transport Issue #27 and separate task-context workflow/runtime instead of reusing historical transport Issue #2 or widening historical schemas.
decisions.rationale: Transport identity, contract validation and publication authority remain auditable and historical publication stays closed and non-generic.

decisions.decision: Permit only tasks/<IXX-NNNN>/context.json as regular 100644 add/replace whose task, Issue, source tcr1 request, canonical bytes, Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 all agree.
decisions.rationale: I09-P0 defines context.json as the only v1 artifact; context.md or generic tasks writes would invent new semantics or arbitrary-writer authority.

decisions.decision: Split publisher and strict status authority into separate protected workflow jobs and runtime modules.
decisions.rationale: Publisher needs minimal contents/PR/issues/actions write but no statuses/merge/approval authority; strict gate gets read plus isolated statuses:write and revalidates exact request/result/Git/PR/CI state.

decisions.decision: Narrowly ignore only canonical generated task paths for automatic pull_request CI while preserving ordinary/mixed/wrong-path automatic CI and push-main CI.
decisions.rationale: Generated-only PRs receive required bootstrap through exact dispatch plus protected-main strict status without a broad tasks bypass.

decisions.decision: Validate Git index type and mode in Repository Bootstrap CI in addition to checked-out filesystem shape.
decisions.rationale: Symlink, executable, tree and 160000 gitlink/submodule forms must fail closed at the repository boundary.

decisions.decision: Treat exact replay as immutable-result reuse and reject request-id reuse with a different normalized fingerprint.
decisions.rationale: Replay cannot create a second commit, PR, dispatch or status and request identity cannot equivocate.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Extend historical-ledger publication schemas or make historical publisher a generic tasks writer.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Issue #47 requires a separate forward-only task-context authority and forbids historical schema widening.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Give publisher statuses:write, merge, approval, direct-main or bypass authority.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That collapses required authority separation and protected PR/ruleset semantics.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Publish or merge a production task pack for Issue #48 during acceptance.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Production materialization belongs to downstream Issue #48; all I09-P2 fixtures were disclosure-safe and closed unmerged.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Generate context.md, extra task files, symlinks, executables, submodules or arbitrary tasks paths.
rejected_alternatives.reason: None are canonical hwm-task-context-pack/v1 publication artifacts.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use PAT, deploy key, new GitHub App credential or execute candidate content.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Built-in job-scoped GitHub Actions tokens and inert Git-object validation are sufficient; new credentials or candidate execution violate the boundary.
